comments.body:
I think it is worth to extend this while touch upon this feature. Indic, Arabic-with-diacritics and Thai still miscount when doing some quick testing. Real CJK would also be nice to add while at it.

`\p{N}` addition is different behaviour from before. Probably what we want, but needs to be documented.

Thanks @eelcoj, extended in the follow-up commit: combining marks are kept inside words (Indic, Arabic with diacritics, Thai) and each Han/Hiragana/Katakana character counts as one word. I documented the `\p{N}` change in a comment on the regex, as I couldn't find a docs page for reading time. Thai without spaces is still only split at spaces, as that needs a dictionary segmenter. Happy to switch the CJK unit if you prefer another rule.

This PR was prepared with the help of an AI assistant (Claude); the contributor has not reviewed it line by line.
